hardware: Arduino Nano ESP32 (ESP32-S3) with INMP441 and SD card
model_source: 123 original WAV/JSON pairs; the two included selected-fold models used the same data split
optional_frontend_command: B selects pcen after the current session stops; A restores logmel
speed_patch: installed and verified automatically by build_flash_included.ps1
build_and_flash: source compilation, wrapper upload, and direct precompiled upload succeeded
training_workflow: both logmel and pcen branches passed isolated one-epoch smoke training, INT8 export, model/header replacement, speed-patch installation, and compilation; the submitted models were not replaced by smoke outputs

same_pcm.manifest: original-audio held-out test.csv; five selected decisions per class

pcen.note: One subwindow had identical quantized features; two near-tied raw INT8 class outputs differed by one unit and reversed the subwindow class. Its aggregated decision agreed.

ambient_output_observation: No playback was intentionally started during the short hardware sessions. LAB080 produced an_minimus_f for 4/5 decisions, and LAB083 produced an_minimus_f for 44/47 decisions. These outputs require target-environment negative-audio validation before using PCEN there.
scope: These checks verify compilation, model/frontend selection, recording integrity, runtime, and PC/ESP32 comparison on tested PCM. They do not establish accuracy for live mosquitoes in the laboratory.
